tags.name: Apps
tags.description: The app, its installation for the merchant and its billing information.

tags.name: Charges
tags.description: Manage charges (taxes and extra fees) applied to items.

tags.name: Employees

tags.name: Orders
tags.description: Read, create, update and delete orders, take payments, refunds and voids, and manage line-item dev notes.

tags.name: Webhook subscription
tags.description: Where CorePOS posts the events the app asked for, of every merchant that installed it.

get.description: Returns the app's webhook subscription, with the secret its requests are signed with. Answers 404 when the app has none.

put.description: Creates the app's webhook subscription, or replaces its URL, events and state. A new subscription is told of the events from then on. The URL must use HTTPS (400), and each event needs the permission to read what it is about (403).

get.description:
Returns the merchant's tipping configuration, including the preset tip suggestions.

This API requires **MERCHANT READ** authority.

put.description:
Replaces the merchant's tipping configuration, including the preset tip suggestions.

This API requires **MERCHANT WRITE** authority.

get.description:
Returns a single order by its UUID, including line items, discounts, totals and transactions.

This API requires **ORDER READ** authority.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: UUID of the order.

put.description:
Replaces an OPEN order: its line items, discounts and totals, and adds the transactions it is sent. A paid, refunded, voided or deleted order cannot be updated (400). Returns the updated order.

This API requires **ORDER WRITE** authority.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: UUID of the order.

delete.description:
Deletes an OPEN order. A paid order is not deleted but voided or refunded through its transactions; deleting it answers 400.

This API requires **ORDER WRITE** authority.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: UUID of the order.

parameters.name: itemUuid

post.description:
Creates an order with its line items, discounts and transactions. An order created OPEN carries no transactions; any other state needs them. Returns the created order.

This API requires **ORDER WRITE** authority.

Records a payment (SALE), a REFUND or a VOID on an order; a refund or void names the transaction it cancels and matches its amount. The order state follows: a sale covering the total pays it, cancelling its sales refunds or voids it. Returns the updated order.

This API requires **PAYMENT WRITE** authority.

parameters.description: UUID of the order.

WebhookEventDto.description: The body of a webhook: one event about an entity of a merchant that installed the app.

id.description: Unique identifier of the event. A webhook delivered again carries the same one, so it can be used to drop duplicates.

type.description: Type of the event: the entity and what happened to it.

entityType.description: Type of the entity the event is about.

entityId.description: UUID of the entity the event is about.

merchantId.description: UUID of the merchant whose entity changed.

source.description: Who made the change: a merchant user on a device (ANDROID) or in the back office (WEB), a THIRD_PARTY_APP, a SERVER_TO_SERVER client, an ADMIN, or the SYSTEM.

data.description: The entity after the change, as the API returns it: an item, an order, an employee, an app. Absent when the entity no longer exists. Events may arrive out of order: its lastModified tells which state is newer.

WebhookSubscriptionSaveDto.description: The webhook subscription the app asks for.

url.description: HTTPS URL CorePOS posts each event to.

events.description: Events the app is told of. Each needs the permission to read what it is about: item events ITEM READ, order events ORDER READ, employee events EMPLOYEE READ.

WebhookSubscriptionDto.description: The webhook subscription of the app: where CorePOS posts the events it asked for, of every merchant that installed it.

url.description: HTTPS URL CorePOS posts each event to.

events.description: Events the app is told of.

isActive.description: Whether events are posted; an inactive subscription keeps its place and resumes from it.

secret.description: Secret the requests are signed with (X-CorePOS-Signature).

entryLocationType.description: Where the customer is asked to enter a tip (e.g. on the payment terminal or on the receipt).

suggestionCalculationType.description: How suggested tip amounts are calculated (e.g. before or after tax).

suggestions.description: Preset tip suggestions offered to the customer.

isEnabled.description: Whether tipping is enabled for the merchant.

TipSuggestionDto.description: A preset tip suggestion offered to the customer during payment.

tipSuggestionId.description: Unique UUID identifier of the tip suggestion.

amount.description: Suggestion value — percentage points for percentage suggestions, or the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents) for fixed-amount suggestions.

amountType.description: How the amount is interpreted: a percentage of the order total or a fixed amount.

isEnabled.description: Whether this suggestion is currently offered to customers.

LineItemChargeDto.description: A charge (tax or fee) applied to a specific line item.

lineItemChargeId.description: Unique UUID identifier of this line-item charge application.

chargeId.description: UUID of the merchant's charge this application was created from.

chargeAmountType.description: How the amount is interpreted: PERCENTAGE (percentage of the line price) or FIXED (absolute amount).

amount.description: Charge value — percentage points (scaled by 100, e.g. 725 = 7.25%) for PERCENTAGE charges, or the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents) for FIXED charges.

isDefault.description: Whether this charge comes from the merchant's default charges.

LineItemDiscountDto.description: A discount applied to a specific line item.

lineItemDiscountId.description: Unique UUID identifier of this line-item discount application.

discountAmountType.description: How the amount is interpreted: PERCENTAGE (percentage of the line price) or FIXED (absolute amount).

amount.description: Discount value — percentage points (scaled by 100, e.g. 1000 = 10%) for PERCENTAGE discounts, or the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents) for FIXED discounts.

LineItemDto.description: A single line of an order: one inventory item (or ad-hoc entry) with its quantity, prices, discounts, taxes and fees.

lineItemId.description: Unique UUID identifier of the line item.

quantity.description: Quantity sold. Fractional for per-unit items (e.g. 2.5 lb); otherwise a whole number.

totalPrice.description: Cash/card total price of the line (unit price × quantity) before discounts.

itemId.description: UUID of the inventory item this line was created from; null for ad-hoc lines.

imagePath.description: Path to the item's image, if one is attached.

name.description: Display name of the line item.

priceType.description: How the item is priced: FIXED, VARIABLE or PER_UNIT.

unitType.description: Unit of measure for PER_UNIT items; null for other price types.

discounts.description: Discounts applied to this line item.

taxes.description: Taxes applied to this line item.

fees.description: Fees applied to this line item.

devNotes.description: Free-form key-value metadata attached to the line item by third-party apps. Not shown to the merchant.

binName.description: Optional identifier (max 200 characters) used to group related line items within an order.

transactionId.description: UUID of the transaction that paid for this line, once paid.

isTaxable.description: Whether taxes apply to this line item.

totalPriceDiscounted.description: Cash/card total price after discounts. Present only when computed.

totalDiscount.description: Cash/card total discount applied to this line. Present only when computed.

finalTotalPrice.description: Final total price, in the smallest currency unit, resolved for the payment type used. Present only when computed.

finalTotalDiscount.description: Final total discount, in the smallest currency unit, resolved for the payment type used. Present only when computed.

finalTotalPriceDiscounted.description: Final total price after discounts, in the smallest currency unit, resolved for the payment type used. Present only when computed.

OrderDiscountDto.description: A discount applied to a whole order.

orderDiscountId.description: Unique UUID identifier of this order discount application.

discountId.description: UUID of the merchant's discount this application was created from; null for ad-hoc discounts.

discountAmountType.description: How the amount is interpreted: PERCENTAGE (percentage of the order price) or FIXED (absolute amount).

amount.description: Discount value — percentage points (scaled by 100, e.g. 1000 = 10%) for PERCENTAGE discounts, or the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents) for FIXED discounts.

PricePair.description: A pair of prices for the same amount under dual pricing: what the customer pays with cash and what they pay with card. When dual pricing is disabled both values are equal.

cash.description: Price paid with cash, in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents).

card.description: Price paid with card, in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents).

transactionId.description: Unique UUID identifier of the transaction.

orderId.description: UUID of the order this transaction belongs to, if any.

post.description:
An item of a merchant that installed the app was created. `data` is the item as the API returns it (ItemDto).

This event requires **ITEM READ** authority.

schema.description: The body of a webhook: one event about an entity of a merchant that installed the app.

id.description: Unique identifier of the event. A webhook delivered again carries the same one, so it can be used to drop duplicates.

type.description: Type of the event: the entity and what happened to it.

entityType.description: Type of the entity the event is about.

entityId.description: UUID of the entity the event is about.

merchantId.description: UUID of the merchant whose entity changed.

source.description: Who made the change: a merchant user on a device (ANDROID) or in the back office (WEB), a THIRD_PARTY_APP, a SERVER_TO_SERVER client, an ADMIN, or the SYSTEM.

data.description: The entity after the change, as the API returns it: an item, an order, an employee, an app. Absent when the entity no longer exists. Events may arrive out of order: its lastModified tells which state is newer.

200.description: The app took the event. Any 2xx status counts; anything else, or no answer within 3 seconds, is a failure and the event is sent again.

schema.description: The body of a webhook: one event about an entity of a merchant that installed the app.

id.description: Unique identifier of the event. A webhook delivered again carries the same one, so it can be used to drop duplicates.

type.description: Type of the event: the entity and what happened to it.

entityType.description: Type of the entity the event is about.

entityId.description: UUID of the entity the event is about.

merchantId.description: UUID of the merchant whose entity changed.

source.description: Who made the change: a merchant user on a device (ANDROID) or in the back office (WEB), a THIRD_PARTY_APP, a SERVER_TO_SERVER client, an ADMIN, or the SYSTEM.

data.description: The entity after the change, as the API returns it: an item, an order, an employee, an app. Absent when the entity no longer exists. Events may arrive out of order: its lastModified tells which state is newer.

200.description: The app took the event. Any 2xx status counts; anything else, or no answer within 3 seconds, is a failure and the event is sent again.

post.description:
An order of a merchant that installed the app was deleted. When the order is later purged, another order.deleted comes without `data`. `data` is the order as the API returns it (OrderDto).

This event requires **ORDER READ** authority.

post.description:
An employee was added to a merchant that installed the app. `data` is the employee: its `id`, `name`, `email`, `role` and `lastModified`.

This event requires **EMPLOYEE READ** authority.
